description: Test suite for the CallbackVisitor class in the HTTP/2 adapter, verifying handling of various HTTP/2 frames and stream events.

classes.name: CallbackVisitor
classes.description: Class responsible for visiting and handling HTTP/2 frames and stream events during testing.

methods.name: OnFrameHeader
methods.description: Handles the beginning of a frame, verifying stream ID and frame type.

methods.name: OnSettingsStart
methods.description: Marks the start of processing SETTINGS frames.

methods.name: OnSettingsEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of processing SETTINGS frames.

methods.name: OnPing
methods.description: Handles PING frames, both regular and acknowledgment.

methods.name: set_stream_close_listener
methods.description: Sets a callback for stream close events.

methods.name: OnBeginHeadersForStream
methods.description: Handles the start of headers for a stream.

methods.name: OnHeaderForStream
methods.description: Handles individual header fields for a stream.

methods.name: OnEndHeadersForStream
methods.description: Marks the end of headers for a stream.

methods.name: OnBeginDataForStream
methods.description: Handles the start of data for a stream.

methods.name: OnDataForStream
methods.description: Handles data chunks for a stream.

methods.name: OnDataPaddingLength
methods.description: Handles padding length in data frames.

methods.name: OnEndStream
methods.description: Marks the end of a stream.
